bridge-type.label: Z-Wave JS Gateway
bridge-type.description: The Z-Wave JS server that acts as a bridge to the Z-Wave network

parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Hostname
parameter.description: Hostname or IP address of the Z-Wave JS server.

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port
parameter.description: Port the remote Z-Wave JS server listens on.

parameter.name: configurationChannels
parameter.label: Configuration as Channels
parameter.description: When set to true, the Z-Wave Command Class "Configuration" is exposed in openHAB as channels instead of Thing configuration. This allows you to modify the configuration in rules, such as changing codes for locks.

parameter.name: maxMessageSize
parameter.label: Maximum Message Size
parameter.description: The maximum size of the message (in bytes) that the Z-Wave JS server can send.

thing-type.label: Z-Wave Node
thing-type.description: A Z-Wave node provided by Z-Wave JS.

channel-group-type.label: Statistics
channel-group-type.description: Communication statistics reported by Z-Wave JS.

channel-type.label: Last Seen
channel-type.description: The last time a message was received from the node.

channel-type.label: Last Awake
channel-type.description: The last time the node was awake.

channel-type.label: Commands Transmitted
channel-type.description: The number of commands sent to the node.

channel-type.label: Commands Received
channel-type.description: The number of commands received from the node.

channel-type.label: Commands Dropped During Transmission
channel-type.description: The number of commands to the node that were dropped.

channel-type.label: Commands Dropped During Reception
channel-type.description: The number of commands from the node that were dropped.

channel-type.label: Response Timeouts
channel-type.description: The number of commands for which no response was received.

channel-type.label: Round-Trip Time
channel-type.description: The average round-trip time for commands sent to the node.

channel-type.label: RSSI
channel-type.description: The received signal strength of the last message from the node.
